analysis: Docs-only PR: docs/developer/serving-performance-qualification.md adds head lines 18-25 (a section on automatic startup calibration) and bumps the date; docs/developer/test.md (patch hunks @@ -1,6 +1,6 and @@ -41,6 +41,51) adds MiMo FP32 preflight-refusal fixture notes and a Startup Performance Recovery test description, and bumps the date. No source, crypto, auth, attestation, billing, cache-storage or protocol behavior changes. The new text states that startup calibration does not qualify a timing envelope, raise concurrency or lower memory reserves, and that full-context independent evidence is still required for a reviewed profile; this is consistent with the existing qualification model and does not weaken it. No threat-model assumption (T-041 cache, TB-011 authorization, etc.) is invalidated. Caveat: the described startup-calibration and test behaviors are claims in docs only. The referenced code (ModelCalibrationPolicy, EngineMeasurementPurpose.startupWarmup, the rate-refresh path) was not in this batch, so whether it actually leaves admission/deadline policy and memory reserves unchanged could not be verified. Later passes should check any code PR that implements it for admission-deadline or resource-availability effects (T-010, T-029). The first unit of test.md (67373c0eff1153bd:0) has no text, only metadata. No findings.
